name: 幻灵菇
evolution: 小灵菇 → 幻灵菇 Lv.20 → 幻影灵菇 Lv.32
description: 头顶的触角比隐藏在伞盖下的面目更能够表达出心情，悄无声息地飘来飘去，通常出现在后半夜。在森林深处大量聚集，散发着淡淡荧光，会吸收周围植物和小型动物的情绪。
descriptionEn: The antennae on its head express its mood better than the face hidden beneath its cap. It drifts about silently, usually appearing in the latter half of the night. It gathers in large numbers deep in the forest, giving off a faint glow, and absorbs the emotions of the surrounding plants and small animals.
